independence.title: Ranked by ingredients and evidence. Never by brand.
independence.intro: Four rules keep every recommendation about your skin, and nothing else.
independence.i1: Ranking is never for sale. Brands cannot pay us, and there are no ads or affiliate links.
independence.i2: A store's catalogue is applied after ranking, only to show what is in stock. Staff cannot reorder results.
independence.i3: A caution, a conflict or an evidence grade cannot be removed or softened on request.
independence.i4: Each ingredient is graded for each concern: A for randomised trials in people, B for smaller human studies, C for lab or anecdotal evidence.

HowItWorksPage.title: How it works
HowItWorksPage.lede: Seven stages, in the order the app runs them, from the first selfie to a product you can trust.

diagram.title: The VISTASY journey
diagram.label: Seven stages in three phases. Before: consent, selfie, questions. The read: thirteen readings, then a routine. After: the product check and progress. Progress loops back to a new selfie every 4 to 12 weeks.

consent.title: Consent first
consent.text: You confirm you are over 18 and choose how long your photo is kept: 30 days, or deleted right after it is scored.
consent.choice: How long your photo is kept

selfie.title: The photo is checked first
selfie.text: One face, looking at the camera, no glasses, in even light and in focus. If the photo fails, the app asks for another and says why. About 30 seconds.
selfie.imageAlt: A woman taking a selfie in daylight.

questions.title: A few questions
questions.text: Skin type, sensitivities, pregnancy, allergies and what you already use.

readings.title: Read three times, region by region
readings.text: The face is aligned and cut into regions: forehead, under-eye, T-zone and cheeks. Each concern is read three times from its region. The median is the score; the spread shows how far to trust it.

routine.title: Ingredients weighted by evidence
routine.text: Your top concerns point to ingredients, weighted by evidence grade: A for randomised trials in people, B for smaller human studies, C for lab or anecdotal evidence. Pregnancy, sensitivity, allergies and EU bans remove ingredients before anything is ranked.

check.title: Any product, checked
check.text: Barcode or label photo. Fits, neutral or caution, with reasons and conflicts against what you own. Doses are estimated from the label, never measured in a lab.
check.verdictText: Denatured alcohol high on the list. Your skin reads sensitive.

progress.title: Progress over scans
progress.text: Repeat in 4 to 12 weeks. Changes are shown with measurement noise taken out.

pilot.title: A pilot, not a pitch.
pilot.text: Six to eight weeks, platform fee waived. An A/B test on your product pages shows what changes with your own shoppers, and we publish a case study at the end.
pilot.head: Pilot terms
pilot.name: Your store, read by VISTASY
pilot.direction: Every retail plan can start this way.

q1.q: Can we pay to rank our products higher?
q1.a: No. Nobody can buy a rank. Your catalogue is applied after ranking, only to show what is in stock, and the best match is shown even when you do not sell it.

q2.q: Can our staff change what shoppers see?
q2.a: No. Store staff cannot reorder results, and a caution, a conflict or an evidence grade cannot be removed or softened on request.

q3.q: Do brands see our shoppers' data?
q3.a: No. Trends go only to retailers, never to brands, and only from people who opted in, in groups of at least 50. Individual data is never sold.

q1.a: Retailers pay for the skin advisor on their sites and in their stores, and you can pay for Premium. Brands pay nothing: we take no brand money of any kind.

q2.q: Do you earn anything from what I buy?
q2.a: No. There are no ads and no affiliate links, and when a product links to a shop, the link earns us nothing.

q3.q: What does a retail plan pay for?
q3.a: The skin advisor on your site and in your stores, your catalogue shown as in stock, staff mode, and reports on what your customers' skin needs, built only from people who opted in. Never a product's rank.

q4.q: Where does your revenue come from?
q4.a: Retailers and subscriptions. Every year we will publish how much came from retailers, from subscriptions and from brands, and the brand line is 0% by rule.

DataPage.title: Your data, in plain words.
DataPage.lede: Where your photo goes, who reads it, how long it stays and how to delete it, in one place.

before.title: Before the scan
before.text: You confirm you are 18 or older and choose how long your photo is kept: 30 days, so your next scan can be compared with it, or deleted right after your results, within 2 days at the latest. Your consent is recorded with each scan.

where.title: Where your photo goes
where.text: Your photo is stored in Frankfurt, Germany. To read it, we send it to Google's Gemini API and to our own image models in London, where copies are deleted as soon as they have been read. Moving every step into the EU is planned.

control.title: What you can delete
control.text: A single scan, or your whole account and its photos, from the app at any time. Scores and your routine are kept so you can track progress.

medical.title: Not a medical diagnosis
medical.text: Scores are cosmetic observations, not medical findings, and we do not name diseases. A blemish reading of 70 or more suggests seeing a dermatologist, and the app says so.

sarah.title: Sarah, the AI assistant
sarah.text: Sarah says she is an AI and only answers from your own analysis, routine and ingredient notes. She cannot invent products or studies, and tells you when she has no data.

retailers.title: What retailers see
retailers.text: In a shop, one session links your read to you, with your consent. Anonymised trends come only from people who opted in, only for groups of at least 50, and go only to retailers, never to brands. We never sell individual data.

email.title: Your e-mail
email.text: We use it to send your sign-in link when your turn comes. Accounts sign in with an e-mail link or, during the preview, a password.
